objects.name: CyberNetSec.io
objects.description: CyberNetSec.io is a cybersecurity intelligence platform providing timely, accurate, deduplicated, and actionable threat intelligence for security professionals. The platform aggregates, deduplicates, and enriches threat data from diverse public sources, mapping all threats to MITRE ATT&CK and D3FEND frameworks with operationally-focused analysis, detection guidance, and mitigation recommendations. Operated by security professionals, for the security community.

objects.name: Jason Gomes
objects.description: Cybersecurity practitioner and founder of CyberNetSec.io with over 10 years of specialized experience in security operations, threat intelligence, incident response, and security automation. Expertise spans SOAR/XSOAR orchestration, threat intelligence platforms, SIEM/UEBA analytics, and cyber fusion centers.

objects.name: Qatar's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT)

objects.description: The government agency of Qatar leading a collaboration with SignQuantum to explore and implement post-quantum cryptography (PQC) to secure the nation's digital infrastructure and government services.

objects.name: Qatar Partners with SignQuantum for Post-Quantum Cybersecurity
objects.description:
## Executive Summary
The State of Qatar, through its **[Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT)](https://www.mcit.gov.qa/en)**, has signed a collaboration agreement with cybersecurity firm **SignQuantum** to bolster the nation's defenses against the future threat of quantum computing. Announced on November 10, 2026, the partnership aims to proactively explore and implement post-quantum cryptography (PQC). The focus will be on developing use cases for quantum-resistant digital signatures and other cryptographic technologies to ensure the long-term security and integrity of Qatar's digital infrastructure and government services, in line with its Digital Agenda 2030.
